SELECT C.RN , C.VIDEO_NO , C.TITLE , C.VIDEO_URL , C.USER_NM , C.FM_REG_DATE FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.VIDEO_NO DESC) AS RN , A.VIDEO_NO , A.TITLE , A.VIDEO_URL , B.USER_NM , DATE_FORMAT(A.REG_DATE, "%Y-%m-%d") AS FM_REG_DATE FROM VIDEO_MASTER A JOIN USER_MASTER B ON A.REG_NO = B.USER_IDX WHERE 1=1
AND B.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schAuthor}, '%')
AND A.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY A.VIDEO_NO DESC ) C WHERE 1=1
AND C.RN BETWEEN (#{curIdx} + (#{pageUnit} * (#{curPage} - 1))) AND (#{pageUnit} + (#{pageUnit} * (#{curPage} - 1)))
ORDER BY C.RN , C.VIDEO_NO DESC
